page.layout: One printed page (left-hand page of an opening). Running head at top left and page number/book reference at top centre; main text in a central column; a bracketed sub-list ("Significabat / Generaliter / Specialiter", "Sunt / Per Synecd.dictum tabernaculum / Atrium") set beside the text with braces; no marginal notes in the left margin; the right-hand page is a fragment of the facing page showing only edge text, not transcribed.

main_text.l: tota stylobatis nixis ad reliqua fustentenda.
Specialiter, munera, officia, & membra in ecclesia,
varia esse, totius corporis sustentacula, dono-
Interna, erant instrumenta omnia ad cultum dei
Significabant autem, omnia varia, pretiosa, san-
cta instrumentorum in ecclesia, (qualia sunt, verbum,
sacramenta, dona varia) ita varia, preciosa, sancta, spe-
ciali ex dei institutione esse, Zach. 14.20.21.
Tabernaculum erat, in quo res sacrae à personis
Significabat eam ecclesiæ partem, quæ ex viuis
in Christo membris constabat. Apocal. 11.2. ἀναλογῶς.
Erat autem decem aulæorum è xylino natiuo

page.notes: Partly illegible in places: the bracketed sub-list items are reconstructed from the braces; the "ἀναλογῶς" Greek word is printed as ἀναλογῶς in the scan (rendered approximately). Right-hand page is a partial facing page and not transcribed. Several words near the gutter and the sidenote fragments of the right page are unreadable.
